items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The Baroness Koenigswarter came and brought me medicine and whatnot.

ctx.x: He said, 'I'm not kidding.' I said, 'Oh, go on with you. You look so fat and healthy.' So when I left England he was right in back of me. So we had a suite of rooms together and Garland used to come and he'd just lay across the foot of my bed all night. we'd sleep like that. I was picking up his sickness. I was getting sick and he was getting well. The Baroness Koenigswarter came and brought me medicine and whatnot. She thought I had a cold but it was Garland. I had to sleep away from him.
